feature: Component Reservation Management — Stock/Requirements List and Reservation Automation

envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-063-001.name: Access Stock/Requirements List — View Existing Reservations
TD-CS-063-001.expectedOutcome: Stock/Requirements List displays existing reservations for the specified material and plant

TD-CS-063-002.name: Convert Planned Order to Process Order — Automatic Reservation Creation
TD-CS-063-002.expectedOutcome: Process order created; component reservations automatically generated from BOM

TD-CS-063-003.name: Verify Reserved Quantities Excluded from Available Stock
TD-CS-063-003.expectedOutcome: Available Stock = Physical Stock - Reserved Quantity; calculation accurate

TD-CS-063-004.name: Execute Backflush Consumption — Automatic Reservation Release
TD-CS-063-004.expectedOutcome: Backflush confirmation posted; reservation automatically released and updated to Completed status

TD-CS-063-AP-001.name: Manually Adjust Reservation Quantity
TD-CS-063-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Reservation quantity successfully updated from original to adjusted value; status remains Open

TD-CS-063-AP-002.name: Manually Adjust Reservation Date
TD-CS-063-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Reservation requirement date successfully updated; status remains Open

TD-CS-063-AP-003.name: Cancel Process Order — Automatic Reservation Release
TD-CS-063-AP-003.expectedOutcome: Process order cancelled; reservation automatically released and updated to Cancelled status

TD-CS-063-NEG-001.name: Shortage Warning — Required Quantity Exceeds Available Stock
TD-CS-063-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: Shortage warning displayed; component shortage is calculated and flagged

TD-CS-063-NEG-002.name: Error — Planned Order with No BOM
TD-CS-063-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: Error message displayed: BOM missing or inactive; conversion blocked; no reservation created

TD-CS-063-NEG-003.name: Authorization Failure — Stock/Requirements List Access
TD-CS-063-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: Authorization error displayed; user prevented from accessing Stock/Requirements List

TD-CS-063-ERR-001.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Planned Order Number
TD-CS-063-ERR-001.note: plannedOrderNumber intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-063-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: Error message: Planned Order Number is mandatory; conversion blocked

TD-CS-063-ERR-002.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Material Number
TD-CS-063-ERR-002.note: materialNumber intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-063-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: Error message: Material is mandatory; reservation creation blocked

TD-CS-063-ERR-003.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Plant
TD-CS-063-ERR-003.note: plant intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-063-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: Error message: Plant is mandatory; reservation creation blocked

TD-CS-063-ERR-004.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Requirement Date
TD-CS-063-ERR-004.note: requirementDate intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-063-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: Error message: Requirement Date is mandatory; reservation creation blocked

TD-CS-063-ERR-005.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Reservation Quantity (during adjustment)
TD-CS-063-ERR-005.note: reservationQuantity intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement during adjustment
TD-CS-063-ERR-005.expectedOutcome: Error message: Reservation Quantity is mandatory; adjustment blocked

TD-CS-063-EDGE-001.name: Reservation Quantity — Minimum Boundary
TD-CS-063-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Reservation created successfully with minimum valid quantity (e.g., 0.001 or 1 depending on UoM)

TD-CS-063-EDGE-002.name: Reservation Quantity — Maximum Boundary (Planned Quantity)
TD-CS-063-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Reservation created successfully with quantity equal to planned quantity (maximum valid boundary)

TD-CS-063-EDGE-003.name: Requirement Date — Current Date (Earliest Valid Date)
TD-CS-063-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Reservation created successfully with requirement date set to current date

TD-CS-063-EDGE-004.name: Requirement Date — End of Planning Horizon (Furthest Valid Date)
TD-CS-063-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Reservation created successfully with requirement date set to end of planning horizon

TD-CS-063-EDGE-005.name: Available Stock — Exactly Zero (Boundary for Shortage Warning)
TD-CS-063-EDGE-005.expectedOutcome: Shortage warning displayed; available stock is zero; reservation may be created but flagged

TD-CS-063-INT-001.name: Integration — Reservation Prevents Sales Order Allocation (PP→SD)
TD-CS-063-INT-001.expectedOutcome: ATP check in sales order excludes reserved quantity; sales order allocation is blocked or reduced

TD-CS-063-INT-002.name: Integration — Backflush Goods Issue Releases Reservation (PP→MM)
TD-CS-063-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Backflush goods issue posted (MM); reservation automatically released; material document created

TD-CS-063-INT-003.name: Integration — Shortage Warning Reflects Real-Time Stock Updates (MM→PP)
TD-CS-063-INT-003.expectedOutcome: Stock update from warehouse (MM) is reflected in Stock/Requirements List (PP); shortage warning is recalculated
